name: coast
note: A 70 s coast trip in seven sections, told by point of view rather than by day: from above -> eye level -> sunset -> turn around to the moon -> that night's astro photo. 90 BPM, every cut on a bar line. Paths are relative to this file.

shots.note: the rarest image first: a camel train from straight above, 60 fps at 0.5x, pulling out from tight. 72.3-75.0 s is the stretch where the drone holds still. Tracked with track.py --color 0-12,170-180/110/90
top-down shots are turned 90 deg in the vertical cut: the whole frame, full screen
the two of them lying in the rock pools: people, from above
the drone tilts up from straight down to the horizon: the frame turns upright with it
the quiet beat: the crowd watching the sun go, the music thins to a pad
turn around: a whip pan to the full moon rising behind us; push in on it (track.py --bright 1974,1178)
the round moon dissolves into a round nebula photographed that night; picture and music fade out together

text.zh: 这里的土是红色的，海水是蓝绿色的。
text.en: The earth here is red, and the sea is blue-green.

text.zh: 回头一看，满月刚好升起来。
text.en: We turned around, and the full moon was rising.

text.zh: 那天晚上，我们在这里拍到了这团星云。
text.en: That night, we photographed this nebula from here.
